name: French Postcodes and Communes
description: The line of the postcode and the commune: with and without a comma, with F- and FR- before the code and the country after the commune, on lines of their own, with a CEDEX, a box and an arrondissement. Original cases written for this corpus from La Poste's addressing guidance, described in our own words; the postcodes and communes are La Poste's base officielle (Licence Ouverte 2.0).
